title: Suppressor and Subsonic Rounds

markdown:
Screwing on a suppressor on a gun makes it a little more unwieldy, but in combination with subsonic rounds, it makes most any gun incredibly silent. Any civilian or military ranged weapon (except the [slingshot](/weapon:slingshot), the [hunting bow](/weapon:hunting-bow), and the [machine gun](/weapon:machine-gun), which simply cannot be made quiet) can modify a silencer onto a gun to give the gun the silent property.

A gun equipped with a suppressor and subsonic rounds can still equip another modification, but suppressors are very expensive and wear out from use and need to be refitted during downtime. A gun with a suppressor can shoot up to 15 rounds before it wears out, causing the weapon to lose the silent feature. A suppressor can be refitted during a short rest, recovering its 15 rounds of durability.

*Special.* You can add a suppressor and subsonic rounds to an otherwise-modded ranged weapon.
